title: Adaptive Cost Profile Factory and Tenant-Warmstart Quant Presets
author: Priya Rao
release_notes: Adds a Cost Profile Factory to generate tenant-scoped batching/caching/quantization presets; introduces a tenant-warmstart path that pre-populates KV cache from sampled traces; includes safe fallback to existing profiles. Expected ~10-15% token cost reduction for mixed chat workloads with <5ms p95 latency impact. Feature gated and rolled out via canary flag.
description: Context: Customers running mixed chat and instruction workloads want predictable unit economics while preserving SLOs. Existing defaults are conservative and require manual tuning per tenant. This PR adds an automated 'Cost Profile Factory' that synthesizes per-tenant starting profiles (batch size, cache TTL and prefill policy, quant tier) derived from short traffic samplers plus historical latency targets. Motivation: reduce manual tuning overhead, avoid one-size-fits-all conservative defaults, and enable safe tenant-level warmstarts for KV-prefill to lower token cost and cold-start overhead. Design summary: - Cost Profile Factory: new service layer (optimizer/cost_factory.py) that consumes a short workload fingerprint (qps distribution, seqlen distribution, recent p95 targets) and produces a versioned profile tied to tenant_id and model signature. Profiles are stored as JSON in config/tenant_profiles/<tenant_id>.json and exposed via the admin API for transparency. - Tenant-warmstart: sampling pipeline (tools/warmstart_sampler) that extracts representative prefixes and uses a prefiller to populate KV cache on Dedicated nodes during onboarding or after model rollouts; warmstart is opt-in via feature flag and per-tenant policy. - Per-op micro-quant presets: config/quant_profiles.yaml contains safe per-operator 4-bit groupwise presets plus a dynamic fallback to 8-bit if perf or quality regressions are detected. - Unit-econ prober: tools/unit_econ_prober simulates candidate profiles locally to estimate cost/token and latency delta; this powers the profile scoring step used by the factory. Implementation notes: - Added optimizer/cost_factory.py (core logic + scoring), tools/warmstart_prefill.py (prefill worker), config/quant_profiles.yaml (presets), api/admin_routes.py additions for profile inspection and manual rollback, tests/cover/unit_econ_prober_test.py, and docs/operational-playbooks/warmstart.md. - The factory runs as a small service inside the runtime controlplane; it does not change the serving path unless a profile is explicitly applied to a tenant. Safety and rollout: - Profiles are created in a 'suggested' state and require admin approval or an automated canary step to apply to production traffic. - Warmstart prefill is disabled by default and requires a tenant opt-in or a Linear-triggered rollout. - The system includes automatic regression detection (quality and latency checks) and will revert applied profiles on regression. Performance/econ results from internal sim: - Mixed chat workload (60/40 chat/instruction): median token unit cost down 12% after applying suggested profile and micro-quant presets. - p95 latency overhead measured at +4ms on Dedicated n1-standard clusters (within SLA). - Fallback to 8-bit quant prevented quality regressions in 2/60 tests during simulated A/B runs. Backwards compatibility: existing tenant configs remain untouched; factory suggestions are additive. Migration/ops: - New admin API endpoints for listing and applying profiles. - DB migration for tenant_profile metadata (idempotent, safe). - Feature flags and rollout playbook included in docs. See release notes for summary.
